title: Untitled
altText: Stunning neon graffiti mural by Mr Blob on a black background, featuring a surreal bird character with glowing cyan wings, a skeletal neon structure, and vibrant light-emission spray effects.
description: Painted for the Festivart festival in Lavagna, this piece renders a surreal bird as a glowing anatomical study: a golden beak and red crest give way to an exposed neon spine and translucent, electrified wing membranes. Set against a black background inside a sketched frame, the composition pushes the artist's signature glow-effects and light-emission spray techniques to full intensity.
